name: George W. Nebinger School
notes: Options thin out after 5th grade. For grades 6–8 the pickup choices are Zhang Sah, Queen & Rook and Butcher’s Sew Shop (Fridays), plus Philly Art Center and Shot Tower through 6th. Fleisher and Mighty Writers are both within a few blocks for children old enough to walk.
The city’s free, city-funded after-school programs do not include one at Nebinger. The nearest are school-based programs at Vare-Washington for its own students.
checkedNoPickup: Christian Street YMCA (1724 Christian St), K–6. Its pickup list does not include Nebinger.
Kids on 12th (204 S 12th St), K–5. Picks up from McCall, Greenfield, ICS, FACTS, Russell Byers and Coppin only.
ZAZZ (1923 Chestnut St), ages 5–12. Guaranteed pickup from Greenfield, ICS and Marian Anderson only.
Philly Music Factory (2100 Chestnut St). Greenfield, ICS and Marian Anderson only. Its sister site MoveMakers at 812 Chestnut does list Nebinger.
Children’s Village (125 N 8th St), ages 5–13, takes CCIS subsidy. No Nebinger pickup is stated. Phone 215-931-0190.

ZAZZ (1923 Chestnut St), ages 5–12. Guaranteed pickup from Greenfield, ICS and Marian Anderson only.

name: Fanny Jackson Coppin School
notes: Coppin dismisses earlier than most programs start. Ask each provider what time they collect children.
Options thin out after 5th grade. For grades 6–8 the pickup choices are Zhang Sah, Makom Community and Butcher’s Sew Shop (Fridays), plus Philly Art Center and the two rec centers through 6th.
The city’s free, city-funded after-school programs do not include one at Coppin.
checkedNoPickup: Christian Street YMCA (1724 Christian St), K–6. It is on Coppin’s 2024 sheet, but the Y’s current pickup list does not include Coppin.
The NeighborHub (formerly Old Pine Community Center). Picks up from McCall, Meredith, Nebinger and St. Peter’s only.
Settlement Music School. Escorts from Meredith, McCall and Nebinger only.
Queen & Rook Game Cafe. Its listed pickup schools do not include Coppin.
ZAZZ (1923 Chestnut St), ages 5–12. Guaranteed pickup from Greenfield, ICS and Marian Anderson only.

alsoListed.title: Also on Coppin’s aftercare pickup sheet
alsoListed.intro: Coppin’s own sheet (posted May 2024) names these too. We haven’t confirmed their current details, so call before counting on them.

name: Vare-Washington Elementary School
notes: Vare-Washington has free before and after school care in the building, through the City’s Extended Day, Extended Year program. The school’s 2026–27 page links an online registration form and names the site director, Ms. Lisa Washington of Greater Philadelphia Community Alliance, 267-401-5488.
Dismissal is 2:54 pm, earlier than at most schools nearby. Most outside programs start at 3:30, so ask each one when its staff collect.

For grades 6–8, Zhang Sah takes children through 8th grade and Queen & Rook through age 16. Ask the other programs about older children. Fleisher is about half a mile away for children old enough to walk.
checkedNoPickup: Philly InMovement. Its Queen Village studio picks up from Meredith, Nebinger, McCall and ICS (Wednesdays); its Bok site from Coppin, Southwark and Kirkbride.
Settlement Music School. Escorts from Meredith, Nebinger and McCall only.
The NeighborHub (formerly Old Pine Community Center). Picks up from McCall, Meredith, Nebinger and St. Peter’s only.
Butcher’s Sew Shop Junior. Meredith, Coppin, Nebinger, McCall (Tuesdays and Thursdays) and Southwark (Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays).
MoveMakers (812 Chestnut St). McCall, Meredith and Nebinger only.
Kids on 12th (1112 Chestnut St), K–5. Picks up from ICS, McCall, Greenfield, Russell Byers, Coppin and FACTS only.
Christian Street YMCA (1724 Christian St). Serves Stanton, ICS and Marian Anderson.
Imagine That Philly. Runs inside Coppin and Nebinger only.

alsoListed.title: Also on the school’s own after-school page
alsoListed.intro: The school’s 2026–27 after-school page describes this program and lists other options nearby.
items: The Rock School for Dance Education (1101 S Broad St), grades 2–4. The school’s page says the Rock School collects students at 3 pm, class runs to 4:15 pm, and families pick up at the Rock School. For more, the page says to reach out to Dr. Barnes at the school.

Other aftercare options in South Philly, as the page lists them: Zhang Sah, Philly Art Center, Mister John’s Music, Sunshine Camp, The Rock School, CoCo Academy, Code Ninjas, InMovement, Queen and Rook, YCCA, Settlement Music, Beehive at Bok, The Dandelion Project, Action Karate (winter and spring break camps), Old Pine Community Center and Tiny Towne Academy (Pre-K families only). The page doesn’t say which of these pick up from the school; the ones whose own pages name Vare-Washington are listed above.

name: Edwin M. Stanton School
dismissalNote: the school’s page gives dismissal as 3:30–3:39 and admission as 8:55–9:00
notes: Stanton has free before and after school care in the building, run by Sunrise of Philadelphia. Enrollment is open all year on Sunrise’s site.
The Christian Street YMCA is a short walk west on Christian St, and the Y’s before-and-after-school page lists that branch as serving Stanton, with care from 7 am and until 6 pm.
Beehive’s 2026–27 after-care list for its Rittenhouse site named Stanton when we read it on October 6. Beehive’s site doesn’t give that location’s address or hours, so ask Beehive directly.

The school’s partners page also names Marian Anderson Recreation Center (740 S 17th St), Mighty Writers and a homework club at Grace and Peace Community Church, without saying what each offers or when. Ask the office.
checkedNoPickup: Zhang Sah. Its pickup list covers Meredith, Jackson, Christopher Columbus Charter, Nebinger, McCall, ICS, St. Mary, St. Peter’s and Vare-Washington, not Stanton.
The NeighborHub (formerly Old Pine Community Center). Picks up from McCall, Meredith, Nebinger and St. Peter’s only.
Settlement Music School. Escorts from Meredith, Nebinger and McCall only, though the school’s page says more than 80 students take part in Settlement’s orchestra program at Stanton.
Philly Art Center. Its Queen Village after-school pickup list does not include Stanton.
Mighty Writers. No South Philadelphia location near the school; its closest, El Futuro at 1025 S 9th St, is about a mile east.

alsoListed.title: Also on the school’s own site
alsoListed.intro: The school’s home page names these activities, without saying when they meet or whether they run after school. Ask the office.
items: Arts, music and dance: Dance Club, African Drum Club, Rock Band, Running Club, Orchestra, Chorus, and a poetry program through Writing Matters. The page says Bainbridge House has provided African drum and dance programming for more than 25 years.
Sports: flag football, track and volleyball, with a doctor-signed physical form required. Intramurals for grades K–5, and the Middle Grades Conference for grades 6–8.
A robotics team, which the page says competed in the 2024 World Championships.

name: General George A. McCall School
dismissalNote: Kindergarten and bus riders at 3:30, grades 1–2 at 3:35, grades 3–5 at 3:37, grades 6–8 at 3:39, per the school’s 2023 bell schedule
notes: McCall has a free before and after school program in the building, run by Sunrise of Philadelphia. After school runs until 5:30 pm.
Ten outside programs name McCall on their own pickup lists.

Options thin out after 5th grade. Zhang Sah takes children through 8th grade, Queen & Rook through age 16, and Butcher’s Sew Shop through 15 (Tuesdays and Thursdays from McCall). Sunrise takes grades 6–8 too.
